name: Burn Down a Forest
subtitle: Idle incremental fire game
promotional_text: A cursed forest swallowed the valley overnight. Burn it back with a match, then a torch, then dragon breath, and watch a meadow grow where the ash falls.
description:
A cursed forest grew over the valley overnight and swallowed the village. You are the village fire-keeper. Burn it back.

Start with a single matchstick. Fire spreads on its own, tree to tree, in chain reactions you set off and steer. Every tree that burns leaves embers to spend on hotter tools: a lighter, a tiki torch, a flamethrower, dragon breath and, for the Elder Tree at the heart of the woods, a meteor shower.

- Fire that really spreads: light one edge and watch the front run
- Tools from a matchstick to a meteor shower, each with its own flame
- Upgrades for heat, spread and ember value
- Helpers that burn alongside you: fire sprites and ember salamanders
- Rabbits, foxes and hedgehogs that always scamper out unharmed, and now and then a golden one that drops a bonus
- A meadow of flowers grows wherever the cursed trees burn away
- A real ending in about 30 to 60 minutes; your progress saves as you go

It is a cartoon and a fairy tale: the forest is cursed, nobody is hurt, and the village gets its valley back.

Free to play with ads. Watching an ad for a boost (2x fire, a helper rush, extra embers) is always your choice, and a short ad can appear at natural breaks. You never need to watch one or buy anything to finish. A one-time purchase removes the ads and doubles your fire for good.

support._about: This game's section on the support page (tools/site_pages.py). Every answer must match what the game shows.
support.restore: Tap Notebook at the top right, turn to the Shop chapter and tap Restore at the bottom of the page.
support.ad_choices: Tap Notebook, turn to Settings and tap Change beside Ad privacy choices. The entry is only there in countries where the law asks for it.
support.sound: Tap Notebook and turn to Settings: Softer, Louder and Mute are at the top.

age_rating.note: Draft answers for the age-rating questions; the owner confirms them in App Store Connect.

product_id_note: Store product id = bundle id + '.' + key (the product_id field). The game uses exactly these ids (scripts/monetization/monetization.gd). In RevenueCat, attach each non-consumable to the entitlement named in revenuecat_entitlement (scripts/monetization/store_config.gd ENTITLEMENT_TO_KEY); the ember packs are consumables and need no entitlement.
ad_placements_note: All rewarded placements share one AdMob rewarded ad unit and the interstitial uses one interstitial unit (store_config.gd); the placement names are only for the game's own bookkeeping.
